title: MerchantOfVenusClientState
description: Data Description Language for the Merchant Of Venus full-state-send

Token.description: A single purchasable/ownable game item -- a good, fare, demand, relic, piece of equipment, drive, deed, IOU, or ship. Which fields are actually meaningful depends on sizeClass; every field is still always present, with a harmless default (0/""/false/[]) when it doesn't apply, same convention as elsewhere in this schema.

sellPrice.description: Meaning varies by sizeClass: cash/barter value for most tokens, trade-in value for a ship, jettison value for a fare, bonus add-on for a demand.

sellType.description: "none" means this token can't be sold at all (e.g. a deed).

sellDestination.description: Where this token goes when sold: into the Cup, back onto its own culture's stock, or simply gone.

isUnlimited.description: True if buying this from a culture doesn't remove it from that culture's stock (e.g. ships).

buyers.description: Culture ids (tradeBases keys) willing to buy this token.

source.description: Culture id this token returns to when drawn from the Cup. Only meaningful for goods/fares/demands; empty string otherwise.

isDisposable.description: True if using this item consumes it (e.g. a Nova Ball).

skipsYellow.description: Drive property: ignores movement cost onto a yellow penalty space.

skipsRed.description: Drive property: ignores movement cost onto a red penalty space.

speed.description: Number of dice rolled per move. Only meaningful for a ship.

holdCount.description: Cargo capacity. Only meaningful for a ship.

myPlayerId.description: index of the individual receiving this JSON in the players array, or null if individual is not a player

curPlayerId.description: index of the current player in the player's array, or null if game has not started yet.

options.description: Contains parameters adjustable during game setup, and then fixed thereafter.

players.description: Every player currently joined, in join order. This order is fixed for the life of the game; it is not turn order (turn order is a separate, dynamically-computed array -- see the existing TURNORDER event, not yet part of this schema). okStartup is meaningless (false) before ValidateSetup.

items.description: Every field is always present; most are simply harmless pre-game defaults (e.g. victoryPoints 0, purchaseState DONE) before the game actually starts, same as okStartup.

switchables.description: dict of player-owned relics that can be switched on and off at the beginning of player turn.

tokens.description: This player's full inventory, including their ship (see Player::GetShip()'s index-0 convention -- deliberately staying implicit, not a separate field).

turnOrder.description: Player ids in turn order; null before turn order has been determined.

tradeBases.description: dict keyed by race name of what's there

tokens.description: This culture's current sellable stock, plus any demand tokens sitting on it.
